info.title: Wafir
info.description: وفر — منصة ويب ترويجية متعددة الأدوار لبطاقة خصم افتراضية (30%) تغطي المطاعم والمقاهي والمرافق حسب المنطقة الجغرافية. يدعم ثلاثة أدوار: العميل (تصفّح وتسجيل)، المالك (إدارة منشأته ومنتجاته مع استيراد Excel)، والمشرف (إدارة النظام بالكامل وسجل التدقيق).

Exchange a valid customer refresh token for a fresh access + refresh

post.description:
Revoke all refresh tokens for the current user (logout-all-devices).
The current access token remains valid until it expires (15 min), but
no refresh token will work — the user must re-login on all devices.

Idempotent — calling twice returns to the original state.

Return all facilities the current user has favorited (visible +

post.description:
Vote on whether a review was helpful or not. Public (no auth required)
— duplicate-vote prevention is handled client-side via a cookie.

NOTE: This increments the counter on every call. The frontend prevents
duplicate votes by storing voted review IDs in a cookie.

AdminLogin.title: AdminLogin
AdminLogin.description: ``identifier`` accepts either the admin email or phone number.

AdminUpdateMe.title: AdminUpdateMe
AdminUpdateMe.description: Request body for PUT /admin/me — full_name is editable, email immutable.

CustomerLogin.title: CustomerLogin
CustomerLogin.description: ``identifier`` accepts either the customer email or phone number.

DashboardStatsOut.title: DashboardStatsOut
DashboardStatsOut.description:
Aggregated counts returned by ``GET /admin/dashboard``.

All eight fields are guaranteed to be present (non-null) so the frontend
can rely on a stable contract instead of falling back to defaults.

MeUpdate.title: MeUpdate
MeUpdate.description: Allowed profile update fields for PUT /api/v1/me.

MyReviewOut.title: MyReviewOut
MyReviewOut.description:
A review with facility info — used by GET /me/reviews (all my reviews
across facilities). Includes the facility name + type for display.

OwnerFacilityUpdate.title: OwnerFacilityUpdate
OwnerFacilityUpdate.description: The subset of facility fields a owner is allowed to edit.

OwnerLogin.title: OwnerLogin
OwnerLogin.description: ``identifier`` accepts either the owner email or phone number.

OwnerRegister.title: OwnerRegister
OwnerRegister.description:
Owner self-registration with facility data.

The owner account is active immediately (can login) but the facility
is created with ``is_approved=False`` pending admin review.

OwnerRegisterOut.title: OwnerRegisterOut
OwnerRegisterOut.description: Owner registration response — no membership, includes facility_id and status.

PendingFacilityOut.title: PendingFacilityOut
PendingFacilityOut.description: Facility with owner info — used in admin pending list.

RefreshTokenIn.title: RefreshTokenIn
RefreshTokenIn.description:
Request body for all three refresh endpoints
(``/auth/refresh``, ``/admin/refresh``, ``/owner/refresh``).

RegisterOut.title: RegisterOut
RegisterOut.description: Extended registration response with membership info.

ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut
ReviewOut.description: A single review with reviewer info (public).

ReviewStatsOut.title: ReviewStatsOut
ReviewStatsOut.description: Aggregate rating stats for a facility (public).

TokenOut.title: TokenOut
TokenOut.description:
Login / refresh response. ``refresh_token`` is issued alongside the
short-lived ``access_token`` so clients can rotate tokens without forcing
the user to re-enter credentials every 15 minutes.

UserCardOut.title: UserCardOut
UserCardOut.description: The card registered under a customer's name + the registration date.
